title: The radio on the pilings
logline: A man at the cannery's pilings at low tide with a small radio and a purple light, from behind, the chimney above him, the tide out. The page doesn't know what he's listening for. It draws the radio's antenna as a line into the page's top edge.

panels.composition: A man from behind at the base of cannery pilings at low tide holding a small radio with its antenna drawn as a line going off the top edge and a small purple light in his other hand, the chimney above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a man seen from behind at the base of cannery pilings at low tide holding a small radio whose antenna is drawn as a line going off the page's top edge and a small purple light in his other hand, a brick chimney above, no words
image.notes: Vol 7: Finn, the radio, the UV light, the cannery pilings. Never named.
